title: Petra and the Orchard
author: Lior Okafor
blurb: Marguerite Thackeray, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
